Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If [Omnimon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, choose 1 of both players' Digimon and delete all other Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may gain ＜Rush＞ for the turn and attack without suspending.
